candidates.name: Apex
candidates.description: (Now Somatic Health: https://somatichealth.com/) At APEΧ, we empower clinicians to improve and expand access to musculoskeletal care. We are on a mission to bridge the gap between in-person and virtual care, through seamless integration and a human-centered design. candidates.name: Virdio Health
candidates.description: Virdio Health offers a groundbreaking in-home physical therapy solution that makes your rehab fun, engaging, and supportive. Relieve Muscle and Joint Pain for You, Your Employees, or Patients
candidates.rationale: Both sell digital/at-home musculoskeletal rehab and pain management to patients, employers, and health buyers with similar product category.

candidates.name: Vori Health
candidates.description: Vori Health is an all-inclusive health care provider practicing a holistic, integrated approach starting with musculoskeletal care. The organization offers full service physical medicine and rehabilitation medical care, physical therapy, prescriptions, imaging & lab ordering, health coaching, nutritional guidance, community support and premium instructional content. The team consists of carefully selected, board-certified/licensed providers, and provides services that are accessible at the click of a button from the comfort and convenience of a patient’s home. We are different from other virtual companies which offer only physical therapy or physician consultations. We believe a fully integrated approach leveraging the skills of many healthcare professions is optimal to help our members on their journey towards wellness. Vori Health was established to deliver a truly elevated, human-centered, patient care experience through cutting-edge technology, premium content, community, and multidisciplinary care teams.
candidates.rationale: Same MSK digital care category, similar patient/customer base, and overlapping virtual therapy/coaching model.

candidates.name: RivalistsTM
candidates.description: Rivalists™ unifies health data from wearables, apps, and connected devices to deliver highly personalized care for the everyday athlete. *If you pursue an active lifestyle, you’re an athlete, and Rivalists is designed around you.

candidates.name: Mobithera Technology

Our remote physical therapy platform combines advanced AI, motion tracking, and user-friendly design to deliver personalized exercise plans and real-time feedback, enabling effective rehabilitation from the comfort of home. Our mission is to make physical therapy accessible, efficient, and engaging for everyone, breaking down barriers to recovery through innovation and care.
candidates.rationale: Both are digital physical therapy/MSK care platforms using remote guidance, motion tracking, and home rehabilitation for similar buyers.

candidates.name: Aware Health
candidates.description: Aware Health partners with self-insured employers to deliver cost-effective, research-based orthopedic care to employees that promotes awareness, healing, and wellbeing. Orthopedic conditions are one of the top medical costs for US employers. Aware was created to help companies significantly cut costs while getting employees back to work faster by successfully triaging, diagnosing, and optimizing care delivery. Aware uses cutting-edge research to inform clinical decisions, resulting in lower utilization rates for the most costly diagnostics and treatments. Detailed in a published study in PM&R, Aware has had outstanding results with low healthcare utilization rates over 12 months for employees enrolled in its program: <8% imaging, <2% surgery, <9%required specialty care, <2% opioid use, <5% prescription medication use, and <1% litigation rate. We believe in listening generously, equipping clients with knowledge, and developing solid relationships. This approach likely contributed to the <1% litigation rate. Our vision is to partner with employers to create a healthy and empowered workforce that is aware of the most modern care and preventive measures for healing orthopedic conditions.
candidates.rationale: Same employer-focused digital orthopedic/MSK care category, comparable buyer, and overlapping cost-reduction value proposition.

candidates.name: RecoveryOne
candidates.description: RecoveryOne is the only full-body virtual MSK care solution with more than 225 evidence-based clinical pathways, flexible integration capabilities, and configurable care navigation to seamlessly connect patients with the right care at the right time. End-to-end MSK care from RecoveryOne includes virtual MSK triage, personalized physical therapy programs, a dedicated PT, 1-on-1 health coaching, and sensorless computer vision technology for a frictionless experience. RecoveryOne works with healthcare and benefits managers to offer their populations more engaging and effective musculoskeletal care, driving high-impact savings and superior clinical outcomes.
candidates.rationale: Direct MSK digital care competitor with similar virtual PT, coaching, employer/benefits buyer, and comparable scale.
